title: Delicious Portuguese Yeast Bread
description: A traditional Portuguese bread recipe, perfect for serving with meals or as a side dish.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine yeast and warm water, let it sit for 5 minutes until foamy.
2. Add flour, salt, sugar to the bowl and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
3. Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
4. Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
6. Punch down the dough and shape it into a round or oblong loaf.
7. Place the loaf on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, brush with olive oil.
8. Bake the bread for 35-40 minutes until golden brown.
9. Remove the bread from the oven and let it cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes before slicing.
